title: Helsinki 1967 Tube-Ribbon Edition
author: Mikko Patama
instrument: an upright piano with worn hammers (the library does not name its make), in a rehearsal space treated to sound dry
license: the author permits fitting numeric data from the recordings provided the recordings are not distributed (as the project owner relayed it, 28 October 2026)
capture: the Stereo Ribbon preset: a stereo ribbon microphone (Blumlein pair) in player position close to the hammers, 48 kHz/24-bit stereo FLAC
pitch_names: the library names middle C (MIDI 60) C3, an octave under the scientific pitch used here; files are named by MIDI number
mixing: the preset plays notes, release takes and hammer noises at their recorded levels (ampVelTrack 0); release takes and hammer noises sound on key release at group volume 0.2, release takes 3 dB quieter for each second the key was held (releaseTriggerDecay)
decoding: ffmpeg to PCM24 WAV, no gain, trim, resampling, denoising or EQ
